body.name: \(\mathfrak I_{\mathrm{rep}}\)
body.def: The class of inputs for which \(\mathcal H\) is a nonempty compact rational polytope supplied by a finite rational-inequality encoding, \(p,e,\rho,B,\mathcal Y,q^0\) are rational or real-algebraic encoded numbers, \(\pi\) is binary encoded, and positivity, rank, compactness, and feasibility are accompanied by exact certificates.
